entries.test: Contemporaneous reporting (e.g., NYT, February 2026) on whether the Trump administration, via Hegseth and the Department of War, demanded under threat of penalty that Anthropic allow unrestricted military use of its models, including for mass surveillance and autonomous weapons.
entries.note: The parts that can be checked are the reported coercion of Anthropic and the uses demanded. 'Hellbent on using AI absolutely everywhere' and the 'presumably' part about other companies are loose, hedged framing.
